# Land Surface Models

## Carbon pools and fluxes

::: {.corner-note}
Simplified schematic of SIPNET's carbon cycle

```{python}
plots.box_model(observations=False)
```

## Observations

::: {.corner-note}
MODIS LAI, LandTrendr AGB (Landsat), SoilGrids soil carbon, AmeriFlux NEE
:::

```{python}
plots.box_model(observations=True)
```

## Observations: sites and flux towers

::: {.corner-note}
Gray: sites, each a 30″ (about 1 km) pixel. Orange: AmeriFlux FLUXNET towers matched to a site. Equal-area projection centered at 50 °N, 100 °W
:::

```{python}
plots.sites_and_towers();
```

## Observations: eddy covariance

::: {.corner-note}
Schematic. The method: Baldocchi (2003), *Global Change Biology* 9, 479–492
:::

```{python}
plots.eddy_covariance()
```

$$
\text{eddy-covariance flux} \;\approx\; \widehat{\operatorname{Cov}}\big(\text{vertical wind speed},\ \text{CO}_2\ \text{density}\big)
$$

::: {.figure-gloss}
Each value is the sample covariance of the 10–20 Hz measurements over a 30- or
60-minute interval. NEE is this flux plus the change in CO₂ stored below the
sensor.
:::
